title: Typing a size in the quality profile editor changes the other sizes on that row
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

In Edit Quality Profile > Sizes, typing a value into one of Minimum, Preferred or Maximum also changes the other two fields on that row, and saving the profile stores the changed values.

For Example: 

On a row with no preferred or maximum set, typing 7 into Minimum turns Preferred into 229 and Maximum into 232. On a row set to 0 / 567 / 729, typing into Maximum turns Preferred from 567 into 318.6.

### Expected Behavior

Typing into one field changes only that field. The other two keep their values, and an unset Preferred or Maximum stays unset.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Settings > Profiles, edit a profile.
2. Open the Sizes tab.
3. Find a quality whose Maximum shows "Unlimited".
4. Type 7 into its Minimum.
5. Maximum changes from 400 to 232, and Preferred changes too.
6. Save and reopen the profile. The changed values are stored.

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Unraid
- Sonarr: 5.0.0.2569
- Docker Install: Yes (lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:develop-5.0.0.2569-ls193)
- Using Reverse Proxy: Yes (Traefik)
- Browser: Firefox 157.0.1 on Windows 11
- Database: SQLite
```

### What branch are you running?

Develop

### Trace Logs

UI only. The browser console shows no errors while typing into the size inputs. Full console output:

[signalR] Information: Connection disconnected.
[signalR] Information: Connection reconnecting.
[signalR] Information: Reconnect attempt number 1 will start in 0 ms.
[signalR] starting
[signalR] Information: Normalizing '/signalr/messages?access_token=(removed)' to 'http://sonarr-v5.orion/signalr/messages?access_token=(removed)'.
[signalR] Information: WebSocket connected to ws://sonarr-v5.orion/signalr/messages?access_token=(removed)&id=TV2tIg_XEgVyuKxd-i1rtA.
[signalR] Information: Using HubProtocol 'json'.
[signalR] connected
[signalR] received version { version: "5.0.0.2569" }

### Anything else

Related to #9126. Typing above 400 into Maximum snaps it to 400, and the other two fields on the row change at the same time because of this bug.

The component keeps the sizes in the slider's scale (value ^ (1/1.1)). [The slider handler](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/4831dfe91cdceaeba3d441abb3d348c4c53b605a/frontend/src/Settings/Profiles/Quality/QualityProfileItemSize.tsx#L85-L111) converts back with `Math.pow(x, 1.1)`, but [the three input handlers](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/4831dfe91cdceaeba3d441abb3d348c4c53b605a/frontend/src/Settings/Profiles/Quality/QualityProfileItemSize.tsx#L113-L165) pass the other two fields through unconverted. That is why 567 becomes 318.6, and an unset Preferred and Maximum become the slider's end positions, 229 and 232.
